name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support for landholding farmer families to help with farm inputs and household needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000, paid by DBT into the Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

other_conditions: Landholding farmer families as per land records. Excluded: income-tax payers, institutional landholders, holders of constitutional posts, serving/retired government employees and pensioners drawing ₹10,000+/month (Group D/MTS exempt), and practising professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects).

steps: Self-register on the PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner) or via a CSC/State nodal officer; complete e-KYC and land-record verification.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance against yield loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases for notified crops and areas.
benefits: Insurance cover for crop loss. Farmer premium is capped at 2% (kharif food grains/oilseeds), 1.5% (rabi) and 5% (commercial/horticultural crops); the rest is subsidised.

other_conditions: Farmers (owners, tenants, sharecroppers) growing notified crops in notified areas. Enrolment is voluntary.

steps: Enrol before the season cut-off through your bank, a CSC, an insurance-company agent or the National Crop Insurance Portal.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Dept. of Financial Services / NABARD / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Revolving credit facility for farmers, tenant farmers, fishers and animal-husbandry farmers to meet crop and allied expenses.
benefits: Short-term credit at a subsidised rate under the Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (prompt repayers can get an effective rate around 4%). Limit was raised to ₹5 lakh in 2025.

other_conditions: Individual/joint farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, fishers, animal-husbandry farmers, and SHGs/JLGs of farmers.

steps: Apply at any bank branch (commercial, RRB, cooperative) or use the KCC form on the PM-KISAN portal.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
description: Pan-India electronic trading platform linking APMC mandis so farmers can sell to buyers across markets.
benefits: Transparent online price discovery, competitive bidding and direct payment to the seller's bank account.

other_conditions: Farmers, FPOs, traders and commission agents registered with an e-NAM-integrated mandi.

steps: Register on the e-NAM portal or app and complete KYC at the nearest integrated mandi.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing with crop-wise nutrient and fertiliser recommendations for each farm.
benefits: Free Soil Health Card with recommended fertiliser doses and soil-amendment advice.

other_conditions: All farmers.

steps: Register on the Soil Health Card portal or contact the local agriculture office / Krishi Vigyan Kendra for soil sampling.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana – Per Drop More Crop
description: Subsidy support for micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler) to save water and raise yields.
benefits: Subsidy on drip/sprinkler systems, generally up to 55% of cost for small/marginal farmers and 45% for others (states may top up).

other_conditions: Farmers with an assured water source; small and marginal farmers get the higher subsidy.

steps: Apply through the state horticulture/agriculture department portal or the district office.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps and Solarisation)
description: Solar pumps and grid-connected solar power for farmers to cut diesel/electricity cost and earn extra income.
benefits: Central and state subsidy (about 30% each for standalone solar pumps; farmer pays the balance), plus option to sell surplus power.

other_conditions: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, panchayats, FPOs and water-user associations.

steps: Apply through the state nodal agency / DISCOM portal linked from the PM-KUSUM site.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Cluster-based promotion of organic farming with PGS certification.
benefits: Financial assistance per hectare over three years for organic inputs, certification and marketing.

other_conditions: Farmers forming clusters of about 20 hectares (min. 20 farmers) willing to adopt organic farming.

steps: Apply through the state agriculture department or PGS-India regional council.

name: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)
description: Mission to promote chemical-free natural farming through farmer training, bio-input resource centres and cluster support.
benefits: Training, on-farm demonstrations, bio-input support and certification help for farmers adopting natural farming.

other_conditions: Farmers willing to adopt natural farming, organised in clusters through Gram Panchayats/FPOs.

steps: Contact the state agriculture department / KVK to enrol in a natural-farming cluster.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium/long-term loan facility for post-harvest and community farming infrastructure such as cold storage, warehouses and processing units.
benefits: Interest subvention of 3% per year on loans up to ₹2 crore for up to 7 years, plus CGTMSE credit guarantee cover.

other_conditions: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, cooperatives, SHGs, agri-entrepreneurs and start-ups.

steps: Apply on the AIF portal; the loan is sanctioned by a participating bank/NBFC.

name: Formation & Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs)
description: Central scheme to form and support FPOs so small farmers gain scale in inputs, credit and marketing.
benefits: Equity grant, management-cost support for up to 3 years and credit-guarantee cover through implementing agencies (SFAC, NABARD, NCDC).

other_conditions: Groups of farmers (typically 300 in plains, 100 in hilly/NE areas) forming an FPO.

steps: Approach the implementing agency (SFAC/NABARD/NCDC) through the district agriculture office.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Subsidy for buying farm machinery and setting up custom-hiring centres.
benefits: Typically 40–50% subsidy on machinery (higher for SC/ST, women and small/marginal farmers); up to 80% for custom-hiring centres in some categories.

other_conditions: Individual farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, SHGs and entrepreneurs.

steps: Apply on the state agri-mechanization portal (DBT) linked from the SMAM site.

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: Support for horticulture: planting material, protected cultivation, cold chains and post-harvest units.
benefits: Credit-linked back-ended subsidy (commonly up to 35–50% of project cost, depending on component).

other_conditions: Farmers, growers' groups, FPOs and entrepreneurs in horticulture.

steps: Apply through the State Horticulture Mission / district horticulture office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60; monthly contribution ₹55–₹200 depending on entry age, matched by the Government.

other_conditions: Small and marginal farmers aged 18–40 with cultivable land up to 2 hectares; not covered by NPS/EPFO/ESIC and not income-tax payers.

steps: Enrol at the nearest CSC or through the Maandhan portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
description: Development of the fisheries sector: fish farming, cold chain, boats, nets and fisher welfare.
benefits: Subsidy on eligible projects (commonly 40% for general and 60% for SC/ST/women beneficiaries), plus insurance and livelihood support for fishers.

other_conditions: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, SHGs, cooperatives, FFPOs and entrepreneurs.

steps: Apply through the State Fisheries Department or the PMMSY portal.

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
description: Loan-linked support to set up dairy, meat-processing and animal-feed plants.
benefits: 3% interest subvention on loans; credit guarantee cover.

other_conditions: Individuals, MSMEs, FPOs, private companies and Section 8 companies investing in animal-husbandry infrastructure.

steps: Apply on the AHIDF portal; loans are sanctioned by scheduled banks.

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
description: Entrepreneurship support in poultry, sheep, goat, piggery and feed/fodder.
benefits: Capital subsidy of up to 50% of project cost (subject to a ceiling) for eligible units.

other_conditions: Individuals, FPOs, SHGs, JLGs, cooperatives and Section 8 companies.

steps: Apply on the NLM entrepreneurship portal; subsidy is released through the bank loan.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
description: Development and conservation of indigenous cattle breeds and improvement of milk productivity.
benefits: Support for breeding services, artificial insemination, gaushalas and farmer training.

other_conditions: Dairy farmers, breeders, FPOs, SHGs and gaushalas.

steps: Contact the State Livestock Development Board / district animal-husbandry office.

name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
description: Promotion of scientific beekeeping for higher farm income and pollination.
benefits: Training, bee-colony/equipment support and marketing help for beekeepers.

other_conditions: Beekeepers, farmers, FPOs, SHGs and honey-processing entrepreneurs.

steps: Apply via the National Bee Board / state horticulture department.

name: Namo Drone Didi
description: Provides drones to women SHGs so they can offer agricultural spraying services on rent.
benefits: Central financial assistance of about 80% of drone cost (subject to a cap) plus training for a woman pilot and a helper.

other_conditions: Women self-help groups (SHGs) selected through DAY-NRLM / cluster-level federations.

steps: Apply via your SHG federation / district NRLM office or the lead fertiliser company as notified.

name: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
description: Programme to raise farm productivity in about 100 low-productivity agricultural districts by converging existing schemes.
benefits: District-level support in irrigation, storage, credit and productivity improvements.

other_conditions: Farmers residing in the selected districts.

steps: Access through your district agriculture office; benefits flow via existing schemes.

name: Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses
description: Mission to raise domestic pulses production with quality seeds, better yields and assured procurement.
benefits: Seed support, technical help and assured procurement of tur, urad and masoor at MSP from registered farmers.

other_conditions: Farmers growing pulses who register with the procurement agencies (NAFED/NCCF).

steps: Register on the procurement portal notified by NAFED/NCCF through your state agriculture office.

name: DAY-NRLM (Aajeevika) – National Rural Livelihoods Mission
description: Organises rural poor women into SHGs and federations and links them to credit, skills and markets.
benefits: SHG revolving fund and community investment support, bank credit with interest subvention, training and enterprise support.

other_conditions: Rural women from poor and vulnerable households (BPL/SECC-identified), forming or joining SHGs.

steps: Contact your Gram Panchayat, Block Mission Manager or nearest SHG/federation to join an SHG.

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative
description: Initiative to help SHG women build livelihoods that earn at least ₹1 lakh per household per year.
benefits: Training, livelihood diversification, credit and market linkages through DAY-NRLM.

other_conditions: Women members of SHGs under DAY-NRLM.

steps: Speak to your SHG/village organisation or Block Mission Manager.

name: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) – VB-G RAM G (replaced MGNREGA on 1 Jul 2026)
description: Statutory rural wage-employment law that replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026, with a higher guaranteed number of days.
benefits: 125 days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household per year; wages by DBT; unemployment allowance if work is not provided on time.

other_conditions: Rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work. Existing e-KYC-verified MGNREGA job cards stay valid until new Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards are issued.

documents: Job card / Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card

steps: Register at the Gram Panchayat (workers without a job card can still register) and apply for work in writing or via the app.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
description: Provides functional household tap water connections in rural areas.
benefits: Tap water connection to every rural household with service delivery via the village water committee.

other_conditions: All rural households without a tap connection.

steps: Request a household tap connection through the Gram Panchayat / Village Water & Sanitation Committee.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) Phase II – Individual Household Toilet
description: Incentive for constructing an individual household latrine in rural areas.
benefits: Incentive of ₹12,000 for a toilet for eligible households.

other_conditions: Rural households without a toilet – BPL, SC/ST, small and marginal farmers, landless labourers with homestead, persons with disabilities and women-headed households.

steps: Apply through the Gram Panchayat or the SBM-G portal of your state.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Cash incentive to partly compensate wage loss and support nutrition during pregnancy and lactation.
benefits: ₹5,000 for the first living child (two instalments) and ₹6,000 in one instalment if the second child is a girl, via DBT.

other_conditions: Pregnant and lactating women aged 19+ for first child (and second child if girl). Not for women employed with the Government/PSUs or already receiving similar statutory maternity benefits.

steps: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre / health facility or on the PMMVY portal.

name: Mission Shakti (Sambal & Samarthya)
description: Umbrella mission for women's safety and empowerment: One Stop Centres, Women Helpline 181, Shakti Sadan/Swadhar, working women hostels, creches and gender-budget support.
benefits: Emergency rescue, shelter, counselling, legal and medical aid, creche services and hostel accommodation.

other_conditions: Women in distress, working women and children needing care, as per the component.

documents: Identity proof (not mandatory for emergency help)

steps: Call 181 or approach the nearest One Stop Centre / district WCD office.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: Campaign and district-level programme to improve child sex ratio and promote girls' education.
benefits: Awareness, school enrolment drives and convergence with education and health services (no direct cash benefit).

other_conditions: Girl child and families, through district administration.

steps: Engage with the district WCD office, schools and Anganwadi centres.

name: Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0
description: Nutrition and early-childhood-care programme through Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: Supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, immunisation and health referrals for children 0–6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers; nutrition support for adolescent girls in designated areas.

other_conditions: Children 0–6 years, pregnant and lactating women, adolescent girls (per scheme norms).

steps: Register at your nearest Anganwadi Centre.

name: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection)
description: Child-protection mission covering institutional care, foster care, adoption and sponsorship for children in need.
benefits: Sponsorship support (about ₹4,000 per child per month) and shelter, education and counselling for eligible children.

other_conditions: Children in need of care and protection, orphans and children in difficult circumstances (up to 18 years).

documents: Recommendation of Child Welfare Committee / district child protection unit

steps: Approach the District Child Protection Unit or Child Welfare Committee; Childline 1098 for emergencies.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for elderly persons from BPL households under the National Social Assistance Programme.
benefits: Central pension of ₹200 per month (age 60–79) and ₹500 per month (age 80+); many states add their own top-up.

other_conditions: Indian citizens aged 60+ belonging to a BPL household.

steps: Apply through the Gram Panchayat / urban local body or the state social-welfare pension portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly pension for widows from BPL households.
benefits: Central pension of ₹300 per month (age 40–79); states may top up.

other_conditions: Widows aged 40–79 years from BPL households.

steps: Apply through the Gram Panchayat / urban local body or the state pension portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
benefits: Central pension of ₹300 per month (age 18–79); states may top up.

other_conditions: Persons aged 18–79 with 80% or more disability, or multiple disabilities, from BPL households.

steps: Apply through the Gram Panchayat / urban local body or the state pension portal.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
description: One-time assistance to a BPL family on the death of its primary breadwinner.
benefits: Lump-sum assistance of ₹20,000.

other_conditions: BPL households in which the primary breadwinner (aged 18–59) has died.

steps: Apply through the Gram Panchayat / urban local body or the state social-welfare portal.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
description: Free physical aids and assisted-living devices for BPL senior citizens with age-related disabilities.
benefits: Free devices such as walking sticks, hearing aids, wheelchairs, spectacles and dentures, distributed in camps.

other_conditions: Senior citizens aged 60+ belonging to BPL families (or with income up to ₹15,000/month) with age-related disability.

steps: Register at ALIMCO/district-level distribution camps announced by the district administration.

name: ADIP Scheme – Assistive Devices for Persons with Disabilities
ministry: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Free or subsidised aids and appliances to enhance mobility and independence.
benefits: Devices provided free if monthly income is up to ₹15,000, and at 50% cost if income is ₹15,001–₹22,500.

other_conditions: Indian citizens with at least 40% disability holding a disability certificate/UDID.

steps: Apply through ALIMCO or the implementing agency at camps announced by the district administration.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) / Swavlamban Card
ministry: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Single national ID and certificate for persons with disabilities to access benefits across schemes.
benefits: Nationally valid disability certificate and ID card used for pensions, concessions and scholarships.

other_conditions: Persons with one or more of the disabilities recognised under the RPwD Act, 2016.

steps: Apply online on the UDID portal and attend the medical assessment at the designated hospital.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
ministry: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Scholarship for school students with disabilities in classes 9–10.
benefits: Monthly scholarship, book grant and disability allowance as per norms.

other_conditions: Students with 40%+ disability in classes 9–10; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
ministry: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Scholarship for students with disabilities pursuing class 11 to postgraduate/professional courses.
benefits: Maintenance allowance, reimbursement of compulsory fees and disability allowance as per norms.

other_conditions: Students with 40%+ disability in class 11 and above; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Top Class Education for Students with Disabilities
ministry: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
description: Full financial support for students with disabilities admitted to notified premier institutions.
benefits: Tuition/non-refundable fees, living expenses, books and computer allowance.

other_conditions: Students with 40%+ disability admitted to notified top institutions; family income up to ₹6 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Niramaya Health Insurance Scheme (National Trust)
ministry: The National Trust (Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment)
description: Affordable health insurance for persons with autism, cerebral palsy, intellectual disability and multiple disabilities.
benefits: Health cover up to ₹1 lakh per year; premium about ₹250 (BPL) or ₹500 (others) per year.

other_conditions: Persons with the four National Trust disabilities, subject to registration.

steps: Apply through a National Trust registered organisation or the Trust's portal.

name: NHFDC Concessional Loans for Persons with Disabilities
description: Concessional loans for self-employment and skill training for persons with disabilities.
benefits: Loans at concessional interest through State Channelising Agencies and banks; extra support for women.

other_conditions: Persons with 40%+ disability aged 18–60 who are Indian citizens.

steps: Apply through the State Channelising Agency or the NHFDC portal.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
description: Financial assistance for SC students studying after class 10 (class 11 to PhD).
benefits: Maintenance allowance plus payment/reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees as per norms.

other_conditions: SC students in post-matric courses; parental income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Class 9–10)
description: Scholarship for SC students in classes 9 and 10.
benefits: Monthly scholarship for day scholars/hostellers plus an annual ad-hoc grant.

other_conditions: SC students studying in classes 9–10; parental income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students (Class 9–10)
description: Scholarship for ST students in classes 9 and 10.
benefits: Monthly scholarship for day scholars/hostellers plus an annual ad-hoc grant.

other_conditions: ST students studying in classes 9–10; parental income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
description: Financial assistance for ST students in post-matric courses.
benefits: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of compulsory fees as per norms.

other_conditions: ST students in class 11 and above; parental income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: PM YASASVI Scholarships (OBC, EBC and DNT Students)
description: Umbrella scheme of pre-matric and post-matric scholarships for OBC, EBC and denotified/nomadic tribe students.
benefits: Annual scholarship support for classes 9–12 and higher education as per component norms.

other_conditions: OBC/EBC/DNT students meeting the merit criteria; parental income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Top Class Education Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students
description: Full financial support for SC students admitted to notified top institutions.
benefits: Tuition fees, living expenses, books and computer allowance as per norms.

other_conditions: SC students admitted to notified institutions; family income up to ₹8 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: National Overseas Scholarship (SC, DNT and Landless Agricultural Labourers)
description: Scholarship for postgraduate and PhD study abroad for selected disadvantaged groups.
benefits: Tuition, living allowance, airfare and visa costs as per norms for selected candidates.

other_conditions: SC, denotified tribes, semi-nomadic, landless agricultural labourers and traditional artisans; family income up to ₹8 lakh per year; age limit applies.

steps: Apply on the ministry's National Overseas Scholarship portal when applications open.

name: PM-DAKSH (Skilling for SC, OBC, DNT, Safai Karamcharis and Waste Pickers)
description: Free skill development and upskilling programmes for marginalised target groups.
benefits: Free training (up-skilling, re-skilling, short-term and long-term) and placement support.

other_conditions: SC, OBC, EBC, DNT, safai karamcharis and waste pickers aged 18–45.

steps: Register on the PM-DAKSH portal and choose an empanelled training centre.

name: NSFDC Concessional Loans for Scheduled Caste Beneficiaries
ministry: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation
description: Concessional loans for income-generating activities of SC beneficiaries.
benefits: Low-interest term loans for micro-enterprise projects through State Channelising Agencies.

other_conditions: SC individuals with family income below the limit set by the scheme.

steps: Apply through your State Channelising Agency or the NSFDC portal.

name: NSKFDC Schemes for Safai Karamcharis and Waste Pickers
ministry: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation
description: Concessional loans and skill training for safai karamcharis, manual scavengers and their dependents.
benefits: Low-interest loans for self-employment and free skill training with stipend.

other_conditions: Safai karamcharis, identified manual scavengers and their dependents.

steps: Apply through State Channelising Agencies or banks; details on the NSKFDC site.

name: NBCFDC Concessional Loans for OBC Beneficiaries
ministry: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation
description: Concessional loans for self-employment and education among backward-class families.
benefits: Term loans at low interest for income-generating activities and education.

other_conditions: OBC families below the income limit prescribed by the corporation.

steps: Apply through State Channelising Agencies or the NBCFDC portal.

name: NMDFC Concessional Loans for Minorities
description: Concessional loans to minority communities for self-employment and education.
benefits: Term loans at concessional interest through State Channelising Agencies.

other_conditions: Members of notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, Parsis) below the income limit set by the scheme.

steps: Apply through State Channelising Agencies or the NMDFC portal.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Scheme for Social Integration through Inter-Caste Marriage
description: Incentive to couples in a valid inter-caste marriage where one spouse is a Scheduled Caste person.
benefits: ₹2.5 lakh incentive to the couple (part as a fixed deposit).

other_conditions: Couples where one spouse is SC and the other is non-SC, marriage registered under the Hindu Marriage Act, first marriage for both; combined annual income up to about ₹5 lakh; apply within one year of marriage.

documents: Caste certificate of the SC spouse

steps: Apply through the state/district social-welfare office with recommendation of the district magistrate, or the Foundation's portal.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities (Class 9–10)
description: Scholarship for minority-community students in classes 9–10.
benefits: Annual scholarship covering admission/tuition fees, maintenance allowance and books.

other_conditions: Students from notified minorities with at least 50% marks in the previous exam; family income up to ₹1 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Scholarship for minority students in class 11 up to PhD.
benefits: Annual scholarship for admission/tuition fees and maintenance allowance.

other_conditions: Students from notified minorities with at least 50% marks in the previous exam; family income up to ₹2 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minority Students (Professional & Technical Courses)
description: Scholarship for minority students in professional and technical UG/PG courses.
benefits: Course-fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance.

other_conditions: Students from notified minorities with at least 50% marks; family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
description: Free residential CBSE-pattern schools for Scheduled Tribe students from class 6 to 12.
benefits: Free education, boarding, lodging, uniforms and books.

other_conditions: Scheduled Tribe students admitted through the entrance test (NESTS).

steps: Apply during the annual EMRS admission window via the EMRS portal or district tribal office.

name: PM-JANMAN (PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan)
description: Mission to saturate basic services for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs).
benefits: Pucca houses, roads, drinking water, electricity, mobile medical units, hostels and skilling for PVTG habitations.

other_conditions: Members of the 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.

steps: Access through the Gram Panchayat/district tribal welfare office; benefits are delivered via convergence with other schemes.

name: Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan (DAJGUA)
description: Saturation of basic services in tribal-majority villages and aspirational tribal blocks.
benefits: Housing, water, electricity, health, education and livelihood support through convergence.

other_conditions: Scheduled Tribe households in covered villages.

steps: Access through the Gram Panchayat and district tribal welfare office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana (PM Janjatiya Vikas Mission)
description: Value addition and marketing of minor forest produce through tribal SHGs and Van Dhan Vikas Kendras.
benefits: Training, equipment and market linkage for tribal SHG members.

other_conditions: Tribal gatherers and artisans organised in SHGs.

steps: Join or form a Van Dhan SHG through TRIFED or the state tribal department.

name: SMILE – Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise
description: Comprehensive rehabilitation for transgender persons and persons engaged in begging.
benefits: Skill training, livelihood support, shelter (Garima Greh) and medical facilitation.

other_conditions: Transgender persons and persons engaged in begging.

steps: Register on the National Portal for Transgender Persons or contact the district social-welfare office.

name: NAMASTE (National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment & Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
description: Support for sanitation workers: profiling, safety gear, health insurance and alternative livelihoods.
benefits: Occupational-safety equipment, health insurance and capital subsidy/loan support for sanitation workers and waste pickers.

other_conditions: Sewer and septic-tank workers and waste pickers in urban local bodies.

steps: Enrol through your urban local body / NAMASTE profiling drive.

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)
description: Highest-priority ration-card category under the National Food Security Act for the poorest households.
benefits: 35 kg of foodgrains per family per month (free under PMGKAY).

other_conditions: Poorest-of-the-poor households identified by the state – e.g., landless labourers, marginal farmers, widows, terminally ill, disabled and elderly persons without support.

steps: Apply for a ration card at the state food & civil supplies portal or your nearest Fair Price Shop / block office.

name: Priority Household (PHH) Ration Card under NFSA
description: Ration-card category covering priority households under the National Food Security Act.
benefits: 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month (free under PMGKAY).

other_conditions: Households identified by the state under NFSA criteria (coverage: up to 75% of rural and 50% of urban population).

steps: Apply on the state food & civil supplies portal or at your block/ward office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Free foodgrains to all NFSA ration-card holders.
benefits: 5 kg of free foodgrains per person per month for AAY/PHH beneficiaries (extended for five years from 1 Jan 2024).

other_conditions: Households holding AAY or PHH ration cards under NFSA.

steps: No separate application: collect grain from your Fair Price Shop using your ration card (Aadhaar-authenticated).

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)
description: Nationwide portability of ration cards so beneficiaries can draw their entitlement anywhere in India.
benefits: Collect your NFSA entitlement from any Fair Price Shop across states via biometric/Aadhaar authentication.

other_conditions: Existing NFSA ration-card holders, especially migrant workers and families.

steps: Visit any FPS with e-PoS device; check status on the Mera Ration app / IMPDS portal.

name: e-Shram – National Database of Unorganised Workers
description: Registration of unorganised workers to give them a UAN-linked e-Shram card and access to social-security benefits.
benefits: e-Shram card/UAN; accidental death/disability insurance cover of ₹2 lakh under PMSBY (first-year premium borne by the Government) and preference for other social-security schemes.

other_conditions: Unorganised workers aged 16–59 who are not members of EPFO/ESIC/NPS and are not income-tax payers.

steps: Self-register on the e-Shram portal/app or at any CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60; monthly contribution ₹55–₹200 by entry age, matched by the Government.

other_conditions: Unorganised workers aged 18–40 with monthly income up to ₹15,000, not covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS and not income-tax payers.

documents: Savings bank account / Jan Dhan account

steps: Enrol at a CSC or through the Maandhan portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Laghu Vyapari Maan-Dhan (PM-LVM)
description: Voluntary pension scheme for small shopkeepers, retail traders and self-employed persons.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60 with matching Government contribution.

other_conditions: Shopkeepers, retail traders and self-employed persons aged 18–40 with annual turnover up to ₹1.5 crore, not covered by EPFO/ESIC/NPS and not income-tax payers.

steps: Enrol at a CSC or through the Maandhan portal.

name: ESIC Medical and Cash Benefits (Employees' State Insurance)
description: Social-security and health insurance for workers in covered establishments.
benefits: Full medical care for the worker and family, sickness and maternity benefit, disablement and dependants' benefit, funeral expenses.

other_conditions: Employees in covered factories/establishments with monthly wages up to ₹21,000 (₹25,000 for persons with disability).

steps: Registered by the employer; insured persons get an IP number through the ESIC portal.

name: Employees' Provident Fund & Pension Schemes (EPF, EPS, EDLI)
description: Retirement savings, pension and life insurance for salaried employees.
benefits: Provident-fund savings with interest, monthly pension after retirement, and insurance cover for dependants.

other_conditions: Employees in covered establishments; membership is mandatory for those earning up to the statutory wage ceiling (₹15,000/month) and optional above it.

steps: Enrolment is done by the employer; members manage their UAN on the EPFO Member Portal.

name: Building & Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Board Schemes
description: State welfare boards provide benefits such as education aid, medical help, maternity benefit and pension to registered construction workers.
benefits: Scholarships for children, medical/maternity assistance, accident compensation and pension (amounts vary by state).

other_conditions: Construction workers aged 18–60 who worked at least 90 days in the last 12 months.

steps: Register with your state BOCW Welfare Board (online portal or labour office).

name: Employment Linked Incentive (PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana)
description: Incentive scheme to encourage formal job creation for first-time employees and employers.
benefits: First-time employees get up to one month's EPF wage (max ₹15,000) in two instalments; employers get up to ₹3,000 per month per additional hire for two years (longer for manufacturing).

other_conditions: First-time EPFO-registered employees earning up to ₹1 lakh/month in jobs created between 1 Aug 2025 and 31 Jul 2027, and their employers.

documents: UAN activated with Aadhaar-based face authentication

steps: Benefits flow automatically via EPFO if the employer and employee meet UAN/Aadhaar-seeding conditions.

name: Free Legal Aid (NALSA / State Legal Services Authorities)
description: Free legal representation, advice and Lok Adalat services for eligible persons.
benefits: Free lawyer, court-fee exemption and legal advice.

other_conditions: Women, children, SC/ST, persons with disabilities, victims of trafficking or disasters, industrial workers, persons in custody, and persons below the income limit fixed by the State Legal Services Authority.

steps: Apply at the District/State Legal Services Authority or the NALSA online portal; helpline 15100.

name: Tele-Law (Legal Advice through CSCs)
description: Free pre-litigation legal advice by video/telephone via Common Service Centres.
benefits: Free advice from panel lawyers; free for eligible groups (women, SC/ST, disabled, etc.).

other_conditions: Any citizen; free service for groups eligible for legal aid, otherwise nominal fee.

steps: Visit a nearby CSC or use the Tele-Law mobile app.

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
description: Hot cooked meal for children in government and aided schools to improve enrolment, attendance and nutrition.
benefits: Free hot meal on school days for pre-primary to class 8 students.

other_conditions: Students of government, government-aided and local-body schools (pre-primary to class 8).

steps: Automatic for enrolled students; the school implements the scheme.

name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
description: Integrated school-education programme from pre-school to class 12.
benefits: Free textbooks, uniforms for eligible groups, transport/escort support, KGBV hostels, inclusive-education support for children with special needs.

other_conditions: Students in government schools (with additional support for girls, SC/ST and children with special needs).

steps: Access through the school / block education office.

name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV)
description: Residential upper-primary and secondary schools for girls in educationally backward blocks.
benefits: Free residential education, food, books and uniforms.

other_conditions: Girls from SC, ST, OBC, minority communities and BPL families (priority to dropouts and out-of-school girls).

steps: Apply through the block education office / KGBV admissions notice.

name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) Admission
description: Free residential co-educational schools for talented rural children, admission via the JNVST entrance test for class 6.
benefits: Free education, boarding, lodging and uniforms up to class 12; migration between regions.

other_conditions: Children studying in class 5 in a government/aided recognised school in the district where they apply (at least 75% of seats reserved for rural candidates; reservations for girls, SC/ST, PwD).

steps: Apply online for JNVST on the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti portal during the notified window.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Scholarship to prevent dropout of meritorious students from economically weaker families at class 8.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year for classes 9–12.

other_conditions: Class 8 pass students (at least 55% marks; 50% for SC/ST) selected through a state-level exam, studying in government/aided schools; parental income up to ₹3.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
description: Merit-based scholarship for college and university students from lower-income families.
benefits: About ₹12,000 per year for graduation (first three years) and ₹20,000 per year for postgraduation.

other_conditions: Students above the 80th percentile in the class 12 board exam, pursuing regular degree courses; family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (Technical Education)
description: Scholarship to girl students in AICTE-approved technical degree and diploma courses.
benefits: About ₹50,000 per year (tuition plus incidentals) for up to 4 years (3 for diploma/lateral entry).

other_conditions: Girl students admitted to first year of AICTE-approved degree/diploma; family income up to ₹8 lakh; maximum two girl children per family.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
description: Scholarship for students with disabilities in AICTE-approved technical courses.
benefits: About ₹50,000 per year for tuition and incidental expenses.

other_conditions: Students with 40%+ disability admitted to AICTE-approved degree/diploma courses; family income up to ₹8 lakh.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: PM-Vidyalaxmi (Collateral-free Education Loans)
description: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for students admitted to top-ranked higher-education institutions.
benefits: Loans with credit guarantee (about 75% for loans up to ₹7.5 lakh) and interest subvention (3% on loans up to ₹10 lakh for family income up to ₹8 lakh; full subvention for lower-income families not on other scholarships).

other_conditions: Students admitted to Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs) notified by the ministry.

steps: Apply through the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal; banks process the loan.

name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Fellowship for top students to pursue PhD at leading institutions.
benefits: Monthly fellowship (roughly ₹70,000–₹80,000) plus annual research grant for up to 5 years.

other_conditions: Bachelor's/master's graduates admitted to PhD at IITs, IISc, IISERs, NITs and other selected institutions, selected through the PMRF process.

steps: Apply on the PMRF portal during the announced windows.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
description: Scholarship for meritorious students pursuing natural/basic sciences at UG and integrated MSc level.
benefits: About ₹80,000 per year (scholarship plus mentorship grant) for up to 5 years.

other_conditions: Students in the top 1% in class 12 boards or with top JEE/NEET/other exam ranks, studying B.Sc./B.S./Int. M.Sc. in natural and basic sciences.

steps: Apply on the INSPIRE portal in the annual window.

name: INSPIRE Awards – MANAK
description: Programme to nurture creativity and innovation among school students (classes 6–10).
benefits: ₹10,000 award to selected students for developing ideas/models.

other_conditions: Students of classes 6–10, nominated by their schools (one to a few nominations per school).

steps: Schools submit nominations on the MANAK portal.

name: Ishan Uday – Special Scholarship for North Eastern Region Students
description: Scholarship for NER students pursuing general degree, technical or professional courses.
benefits: Monthly scholarship (about ₹5,400 for general degree and ₹7,800 for technical/professional courses).

other_conditions: Students domiciled in North Eastern states, pursuing regular UG courses in eligible institutions; family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per year.

steps: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

name: UGC Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child (PG)
description: Scholarship for the only girl child of the parents pursuing postgraduate courses.
benefits: About ₹36,200 per month for two years.

other_conditions: Single girl child of the family, aged up to 30, enrolled in regular full-time PG course.

steps: Apply through the UGC scholarship portal / NSP as notified.

name: SWAYAM – Free Online Courses
description: National platform offering free online courses from school level to postgraduate.
benefits: Free access to courses; optional paid proctored exam and certificate.

other_conditions: Any learner; no eligibility restriction.

steps: Create a free account on the SWAYAM portal and enrol in courses.

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Wards of Ex-Servicemen and CAPF
ministry: Kendriya Sainik Board / Ministry of Defence
description: Scholarship for children and widows of ex-servicemen, Coast Guard, and central armed police forces personnel for technical/professional degrees.
benefits: About ₹3,000 per month for boys and ₹3,600 per month for girls.

other_conditions: Wards/widows of ex-servicemen and eligible CAPF/Rashtriya Rifles personnel with at least 60% marks in class 12, in eligible professional courses.

steps: Apply on the Kendriya Sainik Board portal during the annual window.

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest publicly funded health-assurance scheme covering secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
benefits: Cashless cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled public and private hospitals.

other_conditions: Poor and vulnerable families identified through SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and occupational categories (rural and urban); no cap on family size or age. Some states extend coverage further.

steps: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY portal/helpline 14555 and get an Ayushman card through a CSC, empanelled hospital or the Ayushman app.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana Card (PM-JAY for Senior Citizens 70+)
description: Extension of PM-JAY covering all senior citizens aged 70 and above irrespective of income.
benefits: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year (shared among 70+ members of the family); additional top-up for those already covered.

other_conditions: All Indian citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of income; those covered under CGHS/ECHS/other public schemes may choose one.

steps: Enrol on the Ayushman Bharat beneficiary portal / Ayushman app or at a CSC.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission – ABHA Health ID
description: Free 14-digit ABHA number and health account to store and share medical records digitally.
benefits: Digital health ID, linkage of records across hospitals and labs, and paperless care.

other_conditions: Any Indian resident.

documents: Aadhaar or mobile number / driving licence

steps: Create an ABHA number on the ABDM portal, ABHA app or at a participating facility.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Network of Jan Aushadhi Kendras selling quality generic medicines at low prices.
benefits: Medicines at prices commonly 50–80% lower than branded equivalents; entrepreneurs can open a Kendra with incentives.

other_conditions: Any person can buy; individuals, doctors, pharmacists, NGOs and institutions can apply to open a Kendra.

documents: Pharmacist registration / drug licence (for a Kendra)

steps: Buy at any Kendra; apply to open one on the PMBJP portal.

name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (Nutritional Support for TB Patients)
description: Monthly nutrition support to notified tuberculosis patients during treatment.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month via DBT for the duration of treatment (raised from ₹500 in 2024).

other_conditions: TB patients notified on the Ni-kshay portal and on treatment.

steps: Enrol through the treating health facility/ASHA; the benefit is credited by DBT.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Cash assistance to promote institutional deliveries and reduce maternal and infant deaths.
benefits: Cash incentive for institutional delivery (higher in low-performing states: about ₹1,400 rural / ₹1,000 urban).

other_conditions: Pregnant women delivering in public/accredited facilities – all women in low-performing states; BPL/SC/ST women in other states.

steps: Register at the nearest health centre / ASHA worker.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
description: Free entitlements for pregnant women and sick newborns in public health facilities.
benefits: Free delivery including caesarean, drugs, diagnostics, diet, blood and transport.

other_conditions: All pregnant women delivering in public facilities and sick infants up to one year.

steps: Visit a public health facility; contact the ASHA/ANM.

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
description: Free specialist antenatal check-up for pregnant women on the 9th of every month.
benefits: Free antenatal check-ups, tests and high-risk pregnancy identification.

other_conditions: Pregnant women in their second or third trimester.

steps: Visit a government health facility on the 9th of each month.

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
description: Free child-health screening and early intervention for defects at birth, deficiencies, diseases and developmental delays.
benefits: Free screening, referral and treatment (including surgeries) for children aged 0–18 years.

other_conditions: Children 0–18 years in the community, Anganwadis and government schools.

steps: Screening is done by mobile health teams at Anganwadis/schools; contact the district DEIC.

name: Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP)
description: Free vaccination against vaccine-preventable diseases for children and pregnant women.
benefits: Free vaccines including BCG, polio, DPT, measles-rubella, rotavirus, PCV and others per schedule.

other_conditions: Infants, children and pregnant women.

steps: Visit the nearest health centre/Anganwadi on immunisation days; register on the U-WIN app.

name: eSanjeevani – National Telemedicine Service
description: Free doctor-to-patient and doctor-to-doctor telemedicine.
benefits: Free video/phone consultation and e-prescription.

other_conditions: Any patient.

steps: Register on the eSanjeevani portal/app or visit a Health & Wellness Centre.

name: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme
description: Free dialysis services at district hospitals for poor patients.
benefits: Free dialysis sessions for eligible patients.

other_conditions: Patients with kidney failure below the poverty line; others may pay subsidised rates.

steps: Approach the dialysis unit at your district hospital.

name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN)
description: Financial assistance to BPL patients for treatment of life-threatening diseases at government hospitals.
benefits: One-time financial assistance towards treatment costs (ceiling as per scheme rules).

other_conditions: Patients below the poverty line (as per the state BPL threshold) receiving treatment in specified government hospitals.

steps: Apply through the medical superintendent of the government hospital.

name: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS)
description: Cashless medical care for ex-servicemen pensioners and their dependants.
benefits: Cashless treatment at ECHS polyclinics and empanelled hospitals.

other_conditions: Ex-servicemen pensioners and dependants (one-time contribution based on rank).

steps: Apply at the nearest ECHS polyclinic or via the ECHS portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Free short-term skill training with assessment and certification, plus placement support.
benefits: Free training, NSQF-aligned certificate and job-placement assistance.

other_conditions: Indian youth (school/college dropouts and unemployed) aged about 15–45 – see the Skill India portal for current age/course rules.

steps: Register on the Skill India Digital portal and choose an accredited training centre.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Supports employers in engaging apprentices by sharing part of the stipend and basic-training cost.
benefits: Paid apprenticeship with certification; Government reimburses 25% of stipend (up to about ₹1,500 per month) to employers.

other_conditions: Persons aged 14+ with the qualifications required for the trade; employers registered on the Apprenticeship portal.

steps: Register on the Apprenticeship India portal and apply to establishments offering apprenticeships.

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
description: Apprenticeship training for graduates, diploma holders and vocational-course pass-outs.
benefits: On-the-job training with stipend; Government shares part of the stipend with the employer.

other_conditions: Graduates, diploma and vocational-stream candidates seeking apprenticeship.

steps: Register on the NATS portal and apply to listed establishments.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Free residential/non-residential skilling and placement for poor rural youth.
benefits: Free training, food/lodging, certification and placement support.

other_conditions: Rural youth aged 15–35 from poor households (up to 45 for special categories such as persons with disability, PVTGs and women).

steps: Register on the DDU-GKY portal or contact a training partner/Block office.

name: Rural Self-Employment Training Institutes (RSETI)
description: Free short-term residential self-employment training with credit linkage, run by banks in each district.
benefits: Free training (1–6 weeks), boarding/lodging and post-training handholding for loans.

other_conditions: Rural youth aged 18–45, priority to BPL households, women and SC/ST candidates.

steps: Contact your district RSETI (run by a lead bank) for upcoming batches.

name: PM Internship Scheme
description: 12-month internships in top companies for young people to gain real-world experience.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹5,000 (₹4,500 from Government + ₹500 from company), one-time ₹6,000 assistance and insurance cover.

other_conditions: Indians aged 21–24 not in full-time employment or full-time education; family income up to ₹8 lakh; no family member in a regular government job; certain graduates (IIT/IIM/NLU/CA/MBBS etc.) excluded.

steps: Register on the PM Internship portal and apply to internship opportunities.

name: National Career Service (NCS) Portal
description: Free national job-matching portal connecting job seekers, employers, training providers and career counsellors.
benefits: Free registration, job matching, career counselling and skill-course listings.

other_conditions: Any job seeker (special features for persons with disabilities, women and ex-servicemen).

steps: Register on the NCS portal.

name: Skill Loan Scheme (Credit Guarantee Fund for Skill Development)
description: Bank loans to finance skill-training courses, backed by a credit-guarantee fund.
benefits: Loans of about ₹5,000 to ₹1.5 lakh for training fees without collateral or third-party guarantee.

other_conditions: Students/trainees admitted to eligible skill-development courses.

steps: Apply at a participating bank or through the training provider linked to the scheme.

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS)
description: Vocational training for non-literates, neo-literates and school dropouts, with focus on women and disadvantaged groups.
benefits: Free or subsidised short-term vocational training.

other_conditions: Persons aged about 15–45, priority to women, SC/ST and rural residents.

steps: Contact your district Jan Shikshan Sansthan.

name: MY Bharat (Mera Yuva Bharat) Platform
description: National youth platform for volunteering, internships, events and skilling opportunities.
benefits: Access to volunteering, community programmes, learning and skilling opportunities.

other_conditions: Young people aged 15–29.

steps: Register on the MY Bharat portal.

name: Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH)
description: Digital platform for skilling, education and employment services in one place.
benefits: Free course access, certification and job connect; single skill profile.

other_conditions: Any learner or job seeker.

steps: Create a profile on the Skill India Digital portal.

name: Khelo India Scheme – Athlete Development
description: Talent identification and long-term support to promising young athletes.
benefits: Annual out-of-pocket allowance (about ₹10 lakh per athlete per year) for selected athletes, plus training and coaching support.

other_conditions: Athletes selected via Khelo India Games/talent-identification processes.

steps: Selection is through Khelo India Games/SAI processes; register on the Khelo India portal.

name: Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)
description: Support to elite athletes with medal potential in Olympic/Paralympic cycles.
benefits: Monthly out-of-pocket allowance, training/equipment and international exposure.

other_conditions: Core and development-group athletes identified by the Mission Olympic Cell.

steps: Identification by the sports authority; no open application.

name: Financial Assistance to Needy Artists and Scholarships in Culture
description: Pension/assistance for senior artistes and scholarships for young artistes in the arts.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance for eligible senior artists; scholarships/fellowships for young talent.

other_conditions: Practising artists/scholars meeting age, experience and income criteria of the specific component.

steps: Apply as per the Ministry of Culture notice/portal for the specific component.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans for micro and small non-farm enterprises.
benefits: Loans in four bands: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,001–₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5–10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh for earlier good repayers).

other_conditions: Indian citizens with a business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity in manufacturing, trading or services, including small shopkeepers, artisans, food processors and vendors.

steps: Apply at any bank, RRB, small finance bank or MFI, or through the Udyamimitra portal.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and services.
benefits: Margin-money subsidy of 15–25% (general category, urban/rural) and 25–35% (special categories: SC/ST/OBC/minority/women/ex-servicemen/PwD/NER/hill and border areas) of the project cost.

other_conditions: Individuals above 18, self-help groups, cooperatives and charitable trusts setting up new projects; project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (service); minimum VIII pass for larger projects. No income ceiling.

steps: Apply online on the PMEGP e-portal; loans are sanctioned by banks with KVIC/KVIB/DIC support.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades (e.g., carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, mason, barber, washerman, goldsmith).
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate/ID, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, collateral-free loans (₹1 lakh then ₹2 lakh at 5% interest) and digital-transaction incentives.

other_conditions: Artisans and craftspeople aged 18+ working with hands and tools in one of the 18 trades; not availing similar credit schemes (PMEGP/PM SVANidhi/Mudra) in the last 5 years; one member per family; government employees and their families excluded.

steps: Register at a CSC with biometric Aadhaar authentication on the PM Vishwakarma portal; verified by Gram Panchayat/ULB and district committee.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: Working-capital loans for street vendors to restart and grow their business.
benefits: Collateral-free loans in three tiers (₹15,000, then ₹25,000, then ₹50,000) with interest subsidy on timely repayment and cashback for digital payments (restructured version extended to 2030).

other_conditions: Street vendors with a certificate of vending/identity card or letter of recommendation from the urban local body.

steps: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or through a bank/CSC with ULB verification.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype, trials and market entry via incubators.
benefits: Grants up to ₹20 lakh for validation/prototype and investment up to ₹50 lakh via convertible debentures/debt instruments, routed through selected incubators.

other_conditions: DPIIT-recognised startups incorporated less than 2 years ago that have not received more than ₹10 lakh of other government support.

steps: Apply to a selected incubator through the Startup India portal.

name: Startup India – DPIIT Recognition and Benefits
description: Recognition for eligible startups, unlocking tax benefits, easier compliance and access to government support.
benefits: Eligibility for income-tax exemption (Section 80-IAC, subject to approval), self-certification compliance, fast-track patent examination and access to funding schemes.

other_conditions: Entities incorporated as a private limited company, LLP or registered partnership, less than 10 years old, with turnover below ₹100 crore, working on innovation or scalable business models.

steps: Register and apply for recognition on the Startup India portal.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover to lenders for loans to micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Collateral- and third-party-guarantee-free loans; guarantee cover from the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust.

other_conditions: New and existing micro and small enterprises (manufacturing and services), including women entrepreneurs, through member lending institutions.

steps: Apply for a business loan at a participating bank/NBFC; the lender obtains CGTMSE cover.

name: Udyam Registration (MSME Registration)
description: Free online registration for micro, small and medium enterprises, needed to access many MSME benefits.
benefits: Udyam certificate/number enabling priority-sector lending, collateral-free loans, subsidies, protection against delayed payments and eligibility for government tenders.

other_conditions: Any business meeting the current MSME investment and turnover limits (micro, small or medium).

steps: Register free on the Udyam Registration portal.

name: NSIC Support Schemes for Small Enterprises
description: Raw-material assistance, marketing support, single-point registration for government purchases and credit support for small enterprises.
benefits: Help with raw-material purchase, tender participation benefits, bill discounting and marketing assistance.

other_conditions: Micro and small enterprises registered on Udyam.

steps: Register through the NSIC portal or nearest NSIC office.

name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme
description: Zero Defect Zero Effect certification to improve quality and reduce environmental impact of MSMEs.
benefits: Subsidy on certification cost (higher for micro and small units; extra for women/SC/ST-owned) and handholding support.

other_conditions: Udyam-registered micro, small and medium enterprises.

steps: Register and apply on the ZED portal.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Support to upgrade and formalise micro food-processing units.
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% (up to ₹10 lakh per unit), seed capital for SHG members (about ₹40,000) and training/branding support.

other_conditions: Existing individual micro food-processing units, FPOs, SHGs and cooperatives.

steps: Apply on the PMFME portal / through the District Resource Person.

name: Mahila E-Haat
description: Online marketing platform for women entrepreneurs, SHGs and NGOs to display and sell products.
benefits: Free online marketplace listing and marketing support.

other_conditions: Women entrepreneurs, SHGs and NGOs.

steps: Register on the Mahila E-Haat portal.

name: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (National Handicraft Development)
description: Support for handicraft artisans through design, technology upgrade, training and marketing.
benefits: Skill and design training, tool kits, marketing assistance and exhibitions for artisans.

other_conditions: Handicraft artisans with an Artisan (Pehchan) ID card and artisan groups/cooperatives.

steps: Apply through the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) offices or the portal.

name: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP)
description: Support for handloom weavers with looms, yarn, design and marketing help.
benefits: Assistance for looms and accessories, yarn supply at subsidised rates, design support, and access to Weavers' Mudra loans.

other_conditions: Handloom weavers and workers with a Handloom Weaver ID / Pehchan card and weaver groups.

steps: Apply through the Handloom Development Commissioner office / state handloom department.

name: DAY-NULM (Urban Livelihoods Mission)
description: Skill training, SHG formation and self-employment loans for the urban poor.
benefits: Free skill training, interest subsidy on bank loans for self-employment, and shelter/vendor support for eligible urban poor.

other_conditions: Urban poor households, SHG members, street vendors and unemployed youth in cities and towns.

steps: Apply through your urban local body's NULM cell.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: National mission for universal access to banking through zero-balance basic savings accounts.
benefits: Zero-balance account, RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accident insurance (for cards issued after 28 Aug 2018), overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 and DBT eligibility.

other_conditions: Any Indian citizen aged 10+ who does not have a bank account.

documents: Aadhaar or other officially valid document

steps: Open an account at any bank branch or through a Business Correspondent.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Low-cost renewable life-insurance cover.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life cover for death from any cause; premium about ₹436 per year auto-debited.

other_conditions: Bank/post-office account holders aged 18–50 (cover continues to age 55).

steps: Enrol through your bank/post office or net-banking; renew annually.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Low-cost accident insurance cover.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability; premium about ₹20 per year.

other_conditions: Bank/post-office account holders aged 18–70.

steps: Enrol through your bank/post office or net-banking; renew annually.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for citizens, especially unorganised-sector workers.
benefits: Fixed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60 depending on contribution; nominee gets the corpus.

other_conditions: Indian citizens aged 18–40 with a bank/post-office savings account; income-tax payers are not eligible.

steps: Enrol at your bank branch or through net-banking/mobile banking.

name: National Pension System (NPS)
description: Voluntary long-term retirement savings and pension account open to all citizens.
benefits: Market-linked retirement corpus with tax benefits; partial withdrawal and annuity options.

other_conditions: Indian citizens (resident and NRI) aged 18–70.

steps: Open an NPS account online via eNPS or through a Point of Presence (bank/post office).

name: NPS Vatsalya
description: Pension account for minors, opened and managed by parents/guardians.
benefits: Long-term savings for a child that converts to a regular NPS account at age 18.

other_conditions: Parents/guardians of Indian minors below 18 years; minimum contribution about ₹1,000 per year.

steps: Open online via eNPS or at a Point of Presence.

name: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) for Central Government Employees
description: Assured-payout pension option for central government employees, available from 1 April 2025.
benefits: Assured pension linked to average basic pay (about 50% of the last 12 months' average for 25 years of qualifying service), with family pension and minimum pension assurance.

other_conditions: Central government employees covered by NPS who opt for UPS, and eligible retirees as notified.

steps: Opt in through your Drawing & Disbursing Officer / NPS portal as notified.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small-savings account for the girl child with a government-notified interest rate and tax benefits.
benefits: Interest-bearing account (rate reset quarterly), tax benefits, maturity after 21 years; partial withdrawal for education/marriage after age 18.

other_conditions: Parents/guardians of a girl child below 10 years; up to two accounts per family (three if twins/triplets).

steps: Open at any post office or authorised bank; deposit ₹250–₹1.5 lakh per year for 15 years.

name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
description: Long-term tax-advantaged savings scheme with a government-notified interest rate.
benefits: 15-year account with tax benefits and interest set quarterly; deposits ₹500–₹1.5 lakh per year.

other_conditions: Any resident Indian individual (one account per person); parents can open for a minor.

steps: Open at any post office or authorised bank.

name: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme (SCSS)
description: Government savings scheme for seniors with quarterly interest payouts.
benefits: 5-year deposit (extendable by 3 years) with quarterly interest; maximum deposit ₹30 lakh.

other_conditions: Persons aged 60+ (55–60 for those retired under superannuation/VRS; 50–60 for retired defence personnel).

steps: Open at any post office or authorised bank.

name: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)
description: Post-office deposit that pays fixed interest every month.
benefits: 5-year deposit with monthly interest payout; maximum ₹9 lakh (single) or ₹15 lakh (joint).

other_conditions: Resident Indian adults; parents can open for minors.

steps: Open at any post office.

name: National Savings Certificate (NSC VIII Issue)
description: Fixed-income savings certificate sold by post offices.
benefits: 5-year certificate with compounding interest and tax benefits; minimum ₹1,000, no maximum limit.

other_conditions: Resident Indian individuals; guardians can buy for minors.

steps: Buy at any post office.

name: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP)
description: Post-office savings certificate that doubles the investment over a fixed period.
benefits: Investment doubles in about 115 months (at the current rate); minimum ₹1,000, no maximum.

other_conditions: Resident Indian adults; guardians can buy for minors.

steps: Buy at any post office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Assistance to build a pucca house with basic amenities for eligible rural households.
benefits: ₹1.2 lakh (plains) or ₹1.3 lakh (hilly/difficult/NER) per house, plus ₹12,000 for toilet under SBM-G and 90/95 person-days of wage employment.

annual_income.note: Monthly household income about ₹15,000 (revised Awaas+ norms)

other_conditions: Rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha/dilapidated houses, identified through SECC/Awaas+ survey; revised exclusion criteria (2024) apply, including a household income limit of about ₹15,000 per month.

steps: Beneficiaries are identified via the Awaas+ survey through the Gram Panchayat; use the PMAY-G portal/app for self-survey where enabled.

name: PMAY-Urban 2.0 – Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC)
description: Central assistance to build/enhance a house on own land for eligible urban households.
benefits: Central assistance of about ₹2.5 lakh per house.

other_conditions: EWS (income up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (₹3–6 lakh) and MIG (₹6–9 lakh) urban households not owning a pucca house anywhere in India, with the woman as owner/co-owner where possible.

steps: Apply through your urban local body / the PMAY-Urban 2.0 portal.

name: PMAY-Urban 2.0 – Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)
description: Interest subsidy on home loans for buying or building a house.
benefits: Interest subsidy of 4% on home loans up to ₹8 lakh for up to 12 years (maximum subsidy about ₹1.8 lakh).

other_conditions: EWS/LIG/MIG urban households (income up to ₹9 lakh) not owning a pucca house, taking a home loan for a house of eligible value.

steps: Apply through the lending institution (bank/HFC) registered under the scheme.

name: PMAY-Urban 2.0 – Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)
description: Central assistance for EWS houses built in partnership with states, ULBs or private developers.
benefits: Central assistance of about ₹2.5 lakh per EWS house.

other_conditions: EWS urban households (income up to ₹3 lakh) not owning a pucca house.

steps: Apply through the ULB or the developer's project under the scheme.

name: PMAY-Urban 2.0 – Affordable Rental Housing (ARH)
description: Affordable rental housing for urban migrants, workers and students.
benefits: Rental housing units at affordable rents in ARHC projects.

other_conditions: Urban migrants/workers, students and the urban poor.

steps: Apply through the ARHC project manager / ULB.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Free LPG connections for poor women to move households to clean cooking fuel.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection (financial support for connection, stove and first refill); targeted subsidy on refills (₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 9 refills a year in recent years).

other_conditions: Adult women from BPL and specified priority households (SC/ST, PMAY, AAY, forest dwellers, most backward classes, tea-garden workers, etc.) without an LPG connection in the household.

steps: Apply at an LPG distributor or on the PMUY portal.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar)
description: Rooftop solar for households to cut electricity bills and earn from surplus power.
benefits: Central subsidy of ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW (maximum ₹78,000), plus collateral-free low-interest loans.

other_conditions: Indian households with a valid electricity connection and a suitable roof; not previously subsidised for rooftop solar.

steps: Register on the PM Surya Ghar portal, pick a registered vendor, and get subsidy after commissioning.

name: Common Service Centre (CSC) – Village Level Entrepreneur
description: Programme to run a Common Service Centre delivering government and business services in villages and towns.
benefits: Earn commission on services such as PAN, Aadhaar-related help, banking, insurance, bill payment and e-governance.

other_conditions: Individuals (preferably with basic computer skills) who want to set up a CSC.

steps: Register on the CSC portal and apply to become a VLE.

name: PM-WANI (Public Wi-Fi Network Interface)
description: Framework that lets small shops and entrepreneurs offer public Wi-Fi without a licence.
benefits: No licence or registration fee to become a Public Data Office (PDO); earn revenue from data vouchers.

other_conditions: Individuals, shopkeepers and small entrepreneurs with broadband access.

steps: Register with a Public Data Office Aggregator (PDOA) listed on the PM-WANI portal.

name: Indian Railways Concessions for Divyangjan, Patients and Students
description: Fare concessions for eligible categories of passengers.
benefits: Percentage concession on fares (varies by category and class) for persons with disabilities, certain patients and students on eligible journeys.

other_conditions: Persons with disabilities, patients with specified ailments and students meeting the prescribed conditions.

steps: Obtain the concession certificate/ID as prescribed and book at the reservation counter or online with the eligible category.
